decision.observation: Distinct GOLDEN ornate wire sphere with an acorn-knob on a curved arm at its top-right; a small gold object lies at its base-left on the stone-paved floor. Mossy grotto with hanging green curtains; giant black mushrooms flank. Stone path runs beneath the sphere.
decision.hypothesis: This golden sphere differs from the pale silk orbs and may be a genuine mechanism (bell/gate). The small gold object at its base or the knob could be the trigger.
decision.memory: All pale/dark 'silk' orbs have been inert; a golden variant has not been seen before — worth testing.
